nodes.name: Daily Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs weekdays at 10:00. RBZ typically publishes rates in the morning; adjust the hour once you've observed actual publish times. Weekends/holidays are skipped by the cron itself, but RBZ also skips public holidays, which this schedule does not account for — handled instead by the 'no PDF today' branch below.

nodes.name: Build Date Info
nodes.notes: Builds today's expected PDF URL and the month archive page URL as a fallback.

nodes.name: Try Direct PDF URL
nodes.notes: neverError:true so a 404 doesn't halt the workflow — we branch on statusCode instead.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { status: 'no_rate_published_today', note: 'No PDF found via direct URL or archive page fallback for ' + $('Build Date Info').item.json.todayLabel } };

nodes.name: No Rate Published Today
nodes.notes: End state for weekends/holidays or unexpected site changes. Wire this to a Slack/email alert node if you want visibility into repeated failures vs. expected no-publish days.

nodes.name: Parse Rate Table
nodes.notes: Placeholder parsing logic. Confirm against a real extracted PDF text sample before relying on this.

parameters.columns: rate_date, currency, indicative, indices_bid, indices_ask, indices_mid, rate_bid_zwg, rate_ask_zwg, rate_mid_zwg, source_url
